get.summary: Read values-free protection readiness and activity metadata

enabled.description: Whether the engine has registered values or detector plugins available.

protecting.description: Whether registered values or an active detector are currently configured.

registeredValues.description: Count of loaded exact-match protected values.

policyExcluded.description: Count of discovered registry values excluded by configured policy.

required.description: Whether provider requests are blocked until the registry is ready.

message.description: Values-free operator guidance for the current registry state.

enabled.description: Whether request-time secret-shape detection is enabled.

message.description: Values-free explanation of the secret-shape posture.

enabled.description: Whether request-time PII detection is enabled.

configuredBackend.description: Compatibility string naming the configured PII backend set.

backend.description: Active PII backend names as a compatibility string.

failureMode.description: Whether a required PII backend outage skips that backend or blocks provider traffic.

url.description: Values-free health URL for a single configured network backend.

message.description: Values-free explanation of the current PII posture.

restoredValues.description: Cumulative protected values restored during this proxy run.

withheldFromTools.description: Cumulative protected values withheld from tool-call arguments during this proxy run.

head.summary: Check whether protection status can be evaluated without a response body

post.summary: Preview protection and issue a short-lived send ticket

text.description: Maximum 2097152 bytes when encoded as UTF-8.

protectedValues.description: Optional protected selections; maximum 65536 combined bytes after UTF-8 encoding, trimming, and deduplication.

ticket.description: Opaque, short-lived, single-use authorization for the reviewed provider send.

textSha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact preview text bound to the ticket.

redactedText.description: Preview text with all planned protections applied.

name.description: Values-free detector or registry label for the finding.

source.description: Values-free source category for the finding.

plugin.description: Plugin that produced the finding, when available.

confidence.description: Confidence class assigned by the protection source.

start.description: Inclusive UTF-16 offset into the exact preview text.

end.description: Exclusive UTF-16 offset into the exact preview text; must be greater than start.

origin.description: How this protected value entered the preview.

findings.description: Ordered protected occurrences in the preview text.
